sumInsured: Not specified in extract (policy schedule will show chosen Sum Insured; illustrations show examples like ₹5,00,000)

great.name: Room rent: No limit (base policy)
great.quote: The eligible Room Rent or Room Category applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit', which means that there is no separate restriction on Room Charges incurred towards stay during Hospitalization
great.explanation: No room category/cost capping in the base policy, which helps avoid proportionate deductions due to room upgrade.

great.name: ICU charges: No limit
great.quote: Intensive Care Unit Charges (ICU Charges): The eligible ICU Charges applicable for the Insured Person under the Policy is 'No limit'
great.explanation: No separate ICU cap, reducing large out-of-pocket risk in critical care.

great.name: Restore/Reinstatement: Unlimited Automatic Recharge (same illness allowed; unlimited times)
great.quote: automatically make the re-instatement of up to the base Sum Insured unlimited times in a policy year... Recharge amount can be utilized for same illness as well as different Illnesses.
great.explanation: This is a strong restore benefit: once base SI + bonuses/add-ons are exhausted, the policy can recharge up to base SI unlimited times in the year, including for the same illness.

great.name: NCB does not reduce on claims (non-resetting bonus)
great.quote: In the event of a Claim there is no impact on the accrual of Cumulative Bonus.
great.explanation: Unlike typical NCBs that drop or reset after a claim, this one continues accruing even if you claim—best-in-class feature.

great.name: Built-in Additional Sum Insured buffer: Cumulative Bonus (50% per year) + usable for claims
great.quote: enhance the Sum Insured by 50% flat, on a cumulative basis, as a Cumulative Bonus for each completed and continuous Policy Year
great.explanation: Provides additional Sum Insured over time (up to 100% of base SI) which can be used for covered claims—extra buffer beyond base SI.

great.name: Modern/advanced treatments covered up to Sum Insured (listed procedures)
great.quote: Advance Technology Methods: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person up to the Sum Insured... for treatment taken through following advance technology methods: ... Robotic surgeries ... Stereotactic radio surgeries ... Bronchical Thermoplasty ...
great.explanation: Coverage is explicitly extended to several modern treatment methods under hospitalization expenses (subject to overall SI).

good.name: Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period: 36 months
good.quote: excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with insurer.
good.explanation: A 36-month PED wait is within standard ranges for retail health insurance.

good.name: Specific/Nnamed ailment waiting period: 24 months
good.quote: excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage
good.explanation: 24 months is standard for listed/specific conditions.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Standard 30-day initial waiting period for illnesses (accidents covered immediately).

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 60 days
good.quote: For a period of 60 days immediately prior to the Insured Person's date of admission to the Hospital
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 60 days before hospitalization (reimbursement only).

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 180 days
good.quote: For a period of 180 days immediately after the Insured Person's date of discharge from the hospital
good.explanation: Covers eligible medical expenses for 180 days after discharge (reimbursement only).

good.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered (with conditions)
good.quote: The Company will indemnify the Insured Person... for the Medical Expenses incurred towards Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Home treatment can be covered when medically necessary, subject to conditions and listed disease exclusions under this benefit.

bad.name: Consumables / non-medical items not covered by default (unless Claim Shield optional benefit is chosen)
bad.quote: Any item or condition or treatment specified in List of Non-Medical Items (Annexure – I to Policy Terms & Conditions).
bad.explanation: By default, many common hospital consumables/non-medical items (e.g., gloves, masks, nebulisation kit, etc.) are excluded and can become out-of-pocket unless you opt for 'Claim Shield' (optional).

bad.name: Restore benefit trigger is only after exhausting base SI + bonuses/add-ons (not available early)
bad.quote: The Recharge shall be utilized only after the base Sum Insured, applicable Cumulative Bonus , Cumulative Bonus Super (if applicable) and Plus Benefit (if applicable) have been completely exhausted in that Policy Year.
bad.explanation: Recharge is strong but only activates after exhausting base SI and accrued/add-on buffers. Some policies allow restore earlier; here it is a last-layer benefit.

unclear.name: Co-payment (default/base plan) not explicitly stated; only appears as optional covers
unclear.quote: The Co-payment proportion ( If opted ) shall be borne by the Insured Person on each Claim...
unclear.reference: General Conditions Applicable To All The Benefits And Optional Benefits, point 4; and Optional Benefit 3.2.7
unclear.explanation: The wording describes co-pay as optional ('if opted') but does not clearly confirm that the default policy has 0% co-pay. Verify in the policy schedule whether any co-pay is applied by default.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
